stories.headline: Court ruling ousts CHP leader Özel, police storm party HQ, political crisis escalates across the week
stories.summary: An Ankara regional appeals court annulled CHP's 2023 party congress on May 21, removing Özgür Özel and reinstating Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu as party chair. After Kılıçdaroğlu's lawyers requested enforcement, police raided the CHP headquarters on May 24 with tear gas and batons, forcing Özel and supporters out. Özel then led a march to parliament, was elected parliamentary group chair, and vowed to hold a new congress within 40 days. Imprisoned Istanbul Mayor İmamoğlu called it a 'palace coup,' YSK rejected CHP's appeal, financial markets fell sharply, Bahçeli and DEM Party responded, and CHP local organizations across Turkey held protests. Early-election speculation circulated but AKP leadership denied any such agenda.

stories.headline: MİT captures 10 ISIS militants in Syria including Ankara train station bombing suspect; MİT chief Kalın speaks on Turkey's crisis-mediation role
stories.summary: Turkey's MİT intelligence agency, operating in coordination with Syrian intelligence, captured 10 ISIS militants in Syria and brought them to Turkey, with one linked to the October 2015 Ankara train station massacre that killed 103 people. One detainee requested informant status. Separately, MİT chief İbrahim Kalın gave a speech at the National Defense University describing Turkey as a global crisis-mediator and reaffirming that the 'Terörsüz Türkiye' (Terror-Free Turkey) peace process is on track after PKK disarmament steps. A critical investigative piece questioned whether some detainees were captured or voluntarily surrendered by Syrian authorities.

stories.headline: TCMB tightens credit growth limits and intervenes in currency markets amid political shock
stories.summary: The Central Bank of Turkey (TCMB) lowered mandatory reserve-based credit growth ceilings on May 23 across consumer, vehicle, and overdraft credit categories as a routine macroprudential tightening step. Separately, on May 21-22 — the same day as the CHP court ruling — Borsa Istanbul fell 6% triggering a circuit breaker, TCMB intervened with an estimated $6-7 billion FX sale to stabilize the lira, and Finance Minister Şimşek held an emergency financial committee meeting. Analysts at JPMorgan and HSBC began speculating about a TCMB rate hike at the June meeting; the Wealth Fund made large equity purchases to stabilize the stock market.
